regulators.name: Reserve Bank of India
regulators.statute: Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 (operational 1 Apr 1935)
regulators.mandate: Banking, NBFCs, payment systems (PSS Act 2007), credit information companies, monetary policy, forex (FEMA 1999)
regulators.grievance: RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme — cms.rbi.org.in (free; escalate after 30 days of no reply from the regulated entity)

regulators.name: Securities and Exchange Board of India
regulators.statute: SEBI Act, 1992 (statutory; existed as non-statutory body since 1988)
regulators.mandate: Securities markets: brokers, mutual funds, AIFs, listed companies, FPIs, investment advisers, credit rating agencies
regulators.grievance: SCORES 2.0 — scores.gov.in; SMART ODR for online dispute resolution

regulators.name: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
regulators.mandate: Insurers, intermediaries, web aggregators, TPAs; product oversight; policyholder protection (HQ: Hyderabad)

regulators.name: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
regulators.statute: PFRDA Act, 2013 (statutory w.e.f. 1 Feb 2014; interim body since 2003)
regulators.mandate: NPS and APY: pension funds, central recordkeeping agencies, points of presence, retirement advisers
regulators.grievance: NPS Ombudsman under PFRDA (Redressal of Subscriber Grievance) Regulations, 2015; CRA helplines

regulators.name: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India
regulators.statute: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (Board constituted 1 Oct 2016)
regulators.mandate: Insolvency professionals, insolvency professional agencies, information utilities; CIRP and liquidation process oversight
regulators.grievance: Grievance and Complaint Handling Regulations, 2017 (amended Feb 2026)

regulators.name: International Financial Services Centres Authority
regulators.mandate: Unified regulator for GIFT IFSC: banking, capital markets, insurance, fintech sandbox, aircraft and ship leasing
regulators.grievance: IFSCA complaint channels for IFSC-registered entities

regulators.name: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
regulators.mandate: Refinance and development finance for agriculture and rural India; statutory supervisory role over cooperative banks and RRBs
regulators.grievance: Customers of supervised institutions use RBI Ombudsman route; NABARD itself handles institutional complaints

regulators.name: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation
regulators.mandate: Deposit insurance: Rs 5 lakh per depositor per bank per right (since 4 Feb 2020); insurer of last resort on bank failure
regulators.grievance: Claims routed via failed banks; RBI Ombudsman for related disputes

regulators.name: National Housing Bank
regulators.mandate: Housing finance refinance and development; HFC regulation transferred to RBI on 9 Aug 2019
regulators.grievance: HFC complaints now under RBI Ombudsman

regulators.name: Small Industries Development Bank of India
regulators.mandate: Development finance for MSMEs; fund of funds; refinancing; not a conduct regulator
regulators.grievance: Direct borrow customers: SIDBI grievance desk; otherwise lender's own channels

regulators.name: National Financial Reporting Authority
regulators.mandate: Audit oversight: auditors and audit firms of listed and large unlisted companies; enforcement of accounting and auditing standards

regulators.name: Financial Stability and Development Council
regulators.statute: No statute — created by executive resolution, 2010
regulators.ministry: Chaired ex officio by the Union Finance Minister
regulators.mandate: Apex coordination body: financial stability, inter-regulator issues, financial literacy and inclusion councils, cyber security forum
regulators.grievance: No direct public grievance channel; minutes largely unpublished

regulators.name: National Payments Corporation of India
regulators.statute: Section 8 not-for-profit company (2008), founded by RBI and IBA — not statutory
regulators.mandate: Runs retail payment rails: UPI, IMPS, NACH, RuPay, AePS, NETC — as an RBI-authorised payment system operator under PSS Act 2007
regulators.grievance: Escalate: PSP/bank first, then NPCI, then RBI Ombudsman (covers UPI failures)

leadership.name: Sivasubramanian Ramann
leadership.term_or_note: Former Deputy CAG and CTO Office of CAG

leadership.name: Nirmala Sitharaman
leadership.term_or_note: Ex officio as Union Finance Minister

leadership.name: T. Rabi Sankar
leadership.term_or_note: Portfolios: IT, foreign exchange (post-Oct 2025 rejig); in office as of Sep 2026
